subsystems.name: Dry electrode array
subsystems.role: picks up microvolt-level electrical signals from the scalp without conductive gel.
parts: dry sensors (conductive polymer or metal pins)

subsystems.name: Analog front end
subsystems.role: amplifies and digitises the tiny EEG signals while rejecting noise.

subsystems.name: Signal conditioning and artifact removal
subsystems.role: separates brain signals from muscle, eye-blink and electrical interference.
parts: blind source separation (e.g. independent component analysis)

subsystems.name: AI decoder
subsystems.role: maps patterns of brain activity to an intended command or category.
parts: deep neural networks (convolutional, recurrent or transformer)

subsystems.name: On-device compute and wireless
subsystems.role: runs decoding locally to keep latency low and data private.

subsystems.name: Command interface
subsystems.role: turns decoded intent into actions on phones, computers or other devices.

buildSteps.title: Design the electrode layout
buildSteps.detail: Decide how many electrodes and where to place them on the scalp, balancing signal coverage against comfort and wearability.

buildSteps.title: Build the sensor headband
buildSteps.detail: Integrate dry electrodes into a flexible band that maintains consistent contact without gel, and add impedance monitoring to flag poor contact.

buildSteps.title: Develop the analog electronics
buildSteps.detail: Design low-noise amplifiers and filters to boost microvolt EEG signals and digitise them without picking up interference.

buildSteps.title: Collect training data
buildSteps.detail: Record EEG from many volunteers while they perform mental tasks such as imagined movement, attention to a flashing target, or silent speech attempts.

buildSteps.title: Train the AI decoder
buildSteps.detail: Use deep learning to find patterns that predict the intended task, and apply transfer learning so a new user needs only a short calibration.

buildSteps.title: Implement on-device inference
buildSteps.detail: Optimise the trained model to run on a low-power processor inside the headband, keeping latency low and raw data private.

buildSteps.title: Create the software interface
buildSteps.detail: Map decoded categories to concrete actions — moving a cursor, selecting an option, or controlling a smart device — and provide clear feedback.

buildSteps.title: Test and validate
buildSteps.detail: Measure accuracy, speed and comfort across users, and check that performance holds up outside the lab with movement and electrical noise.

buildSteps.title: Iterate
buildSteps.detail: Refine electrodes, algorithms and user experience based on real-world use, gradually expanding the vocabulary of decodable intentions.

prerequisites.why: dry sensors exist, but achieving high channel counts with stable, low-impedance contact remains difficult.
EEG signals are tiny, so amplification and filtering must be excellent to make decoding possible.
networks can classify motor imagery, P300 responses and some attention states, but general intent decoding is still limited.
small, low-power chips can now run neural networks locally, enabling real-time decoding without sending raw brain data to the cloud.

prerequisites.tech: Understanding of neural correlates of intent
prerequisites.why: we know useful signals for simple tasks, but the brain patterns behind complex intentions are not yet well mapped.

pathway.milestone: consumer EEG headbands for meditation, sleep tracking and simple games
pathway.unlocks: broad familiarity with wearable brain sensing, though not high-fidelity control.

pathway.milestone: research-grade high-density dry-electrode wearables with AI for basic device control
pathway.unlocks: lab and early-adopter applications such as cursor control or drone steering.

pathway.milestone: personalised decoders that allow text entry or multi-step commands without implants
pathway.unlocks: assistive technology for people with severe motor impairment and new hands-free interfaces.

pathway.milestone: seamless cognitive augmentation with high information transfer rates
pathway.unlocks: everyday use, but only if accuracy, comfort, privacy and ethics are addressed.
